body.name: \(\widehat\theta_{\mathrm{eff}}\), based on cohort-mean PPML imputation
body.construction: From \(\overline Y_g=n_g^{-1}\sum_iY_{gi}\), \(\widehat p_g=n_g/N\), and \(\widehat\Sigma_g=n_g^{-1}\sum_i(Y_{gi}-\overline Y_g)(Y_{gi}-\overline Y_g)^{\prime}\), compute \(\widehat\beta,\widehat\mu,\widehat A,\widehat B,\widehat\theta_{\mathrm{CM}},\widehat R,\widehat\kappa,\widehat\Omega,\widehat h_{\mathrm{CM}}\) as defined above; then set \(\widehat b_{\mathrm{cyc}}=\widehat R^{\prime}\widehat\Omega\widehat h_{\mathrm{CM}}\in\mathbb R^q\), \(\widehat K=\widehat R^{\prime}\widehat\Omega\widehat R\in\mathbb R^{q\times q}\), \(\widehat h^{\star}=\widehat h_{\mathrm{CM}}-\widehat R\widehat K^{-1}\widehat b_{\mathrm{cyc}}\), \(\widehat\theta_{\mathrm{eff}}=\widehat\theta_{\mathrm{CM}}-\widehat b_{\mathrm{cyc}}^{\prime}\widehat K^{-1}\widehat\kappa\), and \(\widehat V=\widehat h^{\star\prime}\widehat\Omega\widehat h^{\star}\) on \(\mathcal E_N\). For \(q=0\), all cycle objects are empty, \(\widehat h^{\star}=\widehat h_{\mathrm{CM}}\), and no correction is made; on \(\mathcal E_N^c\), use the declared total fallback \((\widehat\theta_{\mathrm{eff}},\widehat V)=(0,1)\)
